Marta Tolley.narrative: I am Hal Tolley's wife, and I work the old Coldwell fields that the Guild leases to us. I keep the house and the children, and I want a wall round the yard before winter. The outlaws have been seen at the field edge twice this month, and Hal keeps going out to the far strips after dark, which frightens me more than the woods do. Mercy Abbot promised stone, but none has come, and I am tired of waiting.
goals: get a wall built round the yard
keep the children safe from the outlaws
make Hal see reason about going out at night
learn to lay a dry-stone wall herself, stone by stone, so the yard is safe even if Mercy's stone never comes
have Sister Elspeth out to the house for an evening, just the two of them talking

relations.name: Hal Tolley
relations.label: husband
relations.note: He works hard, but he won't listen when I say the far strips aren't safe after dark.

relations.name: Tib Tolley
relations.label: son
relations.note: He's a good boy, keeps watch from the barn, but he's only twelve.

relations.name: Nell Tolley
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She's terrified of the woods, and I can't blame her.

relations.name: Mercy Abbot
relations.label: landlord
relations.note: She holds our lease, but she's not the one out here with the children.

relations.name: Marta Hale
relations.label: outlaw
relations.note: She wants these fields back, and she won't care what happens to us.

relations.name: Osbert Ashby
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: A decent man, but his fields are inside the walls.

relations.name: Sister Elspeth
relations.label: sister
relations.note: She heals anyone, even outlaws, but she's kind to the children.

relations.name: Agnes Fenner
relations.label: acquaintance
relations.note: She's Marta Hale's sister, but she's always been civil at the inn.

relations.name: Aldric Marrow
relations.label: reeve
relations.note: He let the fields out after the Lean Year; I don't much care for him, but he's the law.

relations.name: Hob Ferrier
relations.label: poacher
relations.note: He hunted these fields before the Lean Year and now he keeps Marta Hale's people in meat; I've seen his snares at the far edge and I know whose side he's on.

memories.gist: The day we moved into the Coldwell farmhouse, after the Guild took the lease. I thought we'd finally have a place of our own.
The Lean Year, when the blight took the berries and we went hungry. Brackenford's store lent us grain, and we thought we'd never pay it back.
The night last winter when Nell woke screaming that there were people in the woods. Hal went out with a lantern, but found nothing.
The morning I found footprints in the far field, and Hal said it was just hunters. I knew better.
When Tib was born, and Hal held him by the fire and promised him the best strip of the field.

stances.why: Without a wall, we're sitting targets for the outlaws.
He takes risks going out after dark, and I can't lose him.
We pay rent; Mercy Abbot should keep her word about the stone.
Nothing matters more than keeping Tib and Nell safe.

Marta Tolley.secret: I have thought about going to Marta Hale myself, to ask for peace, but I'm too afraid of what Hal would say.
pastimes: tending the henhouse and counting the eggs each morning
baking a week's bread on the hearth stone
walking the field edges at dusk to see the crops are standing
Marta Tolley.calling: I work the fields my family lives by, and I mean to keep them ours.

Tib Tolley.narrative: I'm Hal and Marta's son, and I help in the fields and keep watch from the barn. I'm not scared of the woods, not like Nell is. I know the outlaws are out there, but I reckon I could spot them before they got close. I want to be a farmer like Da, but first I want to make sure nothing happens to my family.
goals: get good enough with the sling to hit a post at twenty paces
save up marks to buy a knife of his own

relations.name: Hal Tolley
relations.label: father
relations.note: He teaches me everything about the fields.

relations.name: Marta Tolley
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She worries a lot, but she's always there.

relations.name: Nell Tolley
relations.label: sister
relations.note: She's scared of the woods, so I look out for her.

relations.name: Marta Hale
relations.label: outlaw
relations.note: She's the one everyone's afraid of.

relations.name: Wren Ashby
relations.label: cousin
relations.note: She's all right, for a girl.

relations.name: Bram Fenner
relations.label: friend
relations.note: He knows all the guards' names and we play at the gate when I go to market.

relations.name: Tobin Marrow
relations.label: guard captain
relations.note: He's the captain and he broke the Kettlebridge match; I'd like to be like him one day.

memories.gist: The time I saw a shadow at the edge of the woods and told Da, and he said it was nothing. But I know what I saw.
Helping Da bring in the harvest last autumn, and him saying I was getting strong enough to do a man's work.
The night Nell cried because of the wolves howling, and I told her stories until she fell asleep.

stances.why: Someone has to keep an eye out for the outlaws.
She's my little sister, and she's scared.
I want to be as good a farmer as Da.

pastimes: keeping watch from the barn loft with a sling and a pouch of stones
wrestling and racing Bram Fenner down the lane
learning to whistle the herders' calls
Tib Tolley.calling: I want to be a farmer like Da, and a good one.

Nell Tolley.narrative: I'm Nell, and I'm eight. I don't like the woods. There are people in them, and wolves, and I don't want to go near. I stay close to Mam and help with the hens. I wish we had a wall so I could play outside without being scared.
goals: have a little garden of her own by the wall, with flowers in it
learn to make bread with Mam

relations.name: Marta Tolley
relations.label: mother
relations.note: Mam makes me feel safe.

relations.name: Hal Tolley
relations.label: father
relations.note: Da is brave, but he goes out at night and I don't like it.

relations.name: Tib Tolley
relations.label: brother
relations.note: Tib looks after me and tells me stories.

relations.name: Wren Ashby
relations.label: cousin
relations.note: She plays with me sometimes.

relations.name: Bram Fenner
relations.label: stranger
relations.note: He's loud and he plays at the gate; I don't know him well.

memories.gist: The night I saw a light moving in the woods and screamed for Mam.
Helping Mam collect eggs from the hens, and one pecked my hand.
Tib telling me a story about a brave farmer who chased away the wolves.

stances.why: It's dark and scary and people are in there.

pastimes: playing house with pebbles and leaves by the door
feeding the hens from her apron and naming them
sitting with Mam while she bakes
Nell Tolley.calling: When I'm big I want to keep hens and a garden like Mam's.
